Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass (health, categories, products/products-by-id, cart auth guards for missing + invalid tokens, cart full CRUD add→GET→PATCH→DELETE, PATCH qty=0 auto-remove, WELCOME10 validate contract, place-order happy path with WELCOME10 fallback to no-coupon, admin login+verify+orders+offers, geo reverse-geocode, forgot-password/send-otp). Test B (auth happy path, Home tab) — quick-user login (+355695808480/123456) succeeded, tap on add-to-cart-p-7321ec1d65dd fired POST /api/cart → 200 → the + button was replaced by an inline stepper with testIDs qty-dec-p-*, qty-val-p-*, qty-inc-p-*. Test E (stale token) — set mbc_token=stale.invalid.value in localStorage → reload → app storage layer detects invalid JSON and redirects to /login (URL: /login) without any red-screen error or unhandled rejection. No PAGEERROR events observed across any flow. Dialog listeners captured zero alerts during happy paths (expected). Only console noise: 'shadow*' style deprecation warning and pointerEvents deprecation — both known React Native web transitions, not introduced by this fix.

OPTIONAL polish (not caused by this fix): migrate remaining `shadow*` style props to `boxShadow` and `props.pointerEvents` to `style.pointerEvents` — currently emitting on every screen mount.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/hooks/use-cart-actions.ts (110 lines) is clean, DRY, and correctly encapsulates: (a) requireAuth() guard that toasts + routes to /(auth)/login when token is null, (b) handleErr() with defensive 401 detection covering 'Missing bearer token', 'Invalid token', 'Token expired', 'User not found' — matches the actual server strings from /app/backend routes, (c) applyCart() called on success to sync cartQtyMap. Type-safe with CartOpResult return.
All three consumers (home, category, product-detail) now call cartActions.addToCart / setQty and delegate error handling — no more `catch {}` blocks. Verified visually on Home + Category.
Cross-platform toast(): uses window.alert on web and Alert.alert on native — correct for Expo Go which was the user's reported environment.
clearSession() properly wipes token + user + cart state + selectedAddress + appliedCoupon before redirect — no risk of a stale user being visible on the login screen.

Storage layer already rejects invalid-JSON tokens (SyntaxError caught during retrieve), which means even if the hook's 401 recovery didn't fire, corrupted-token reboots still redirect to /login instead of showing a broken app. Belt + braces.

rca_of_issue: Original user-reported RCA (Expo Go, production build): three add-to-cart consumers each had `try { ... } catch {} ` swallowing every error, so when the auth token was stale/missing (typical after a long time on a mobile device), the + button appeared to do nothing. Fix landed in preview code at /app/frontend/src/hooks/use-cart-actions.ts — verified in place: (1) requireAuth() gates on !token and toasts + redirects to /login; (2) handleErr() detects 401 signals from server ('Missing bearer token' / 'Invalid token' / 'Token expired' / 'User not found') and clears session before redirect; (3) any other error surfaces via Alert (native) or window.alert (web) — no silent swallowing. All three screens (/(tabs)/index.tsx, /category/[slug].tsx, /product/[id].tsx) now call cartActions.addToCart / setQty. Backend contract confirmed: /api/cart returns 401 with detail message on missing/invalid token, exactly what the hook's 401 detector expects. The user will get the fix once they redeploy to Expo Go.
